content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 4.4 (Audit Rights) is the sole audit provision binding Corio; Exhibit B (pricing, revenue-sharing fees, payment terms) contains no separate verification right. The clause already delivers most of the playbook's protections — once per calendar year, independent CPA reasonably acceptable to Corio, records-only inspection with no system access, Commerce One bearing all costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%. It fails the fallback only on notice: "reasonable notice" fixes no minimum. I proposed a single-phrase edit setting at least 15 days' notice, leaving frequency and the cost allocation untouched.
